digest.component_or_area: reconciler domain - operation outcome and retry budget
propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome values with enums (Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, DelaySource) and a single fake-clock retry-budget owner to centralize retry envelope across adapter layers
Establish provider-neutral logical-operation contract: logical_id UUID retained across invocations, invocation_count 0-3, cumulative sleep budget 15,000ms, at most three physical invocations

Diagnostic entries limited to allowlist of six keys (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message) with redaction via sanitize_diagnostic seam and 512 code-point truncation per message; overflow at eight entries preserves first seven plus exact sentinel entry
Canonical serialization via existing rebar._store.canonical.canonical_bytes seam produces byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON for equivalent outcomes

After ambiguous write, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state yields recovered, failed/inconclusive observation yields non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden
Authoritative provider delay is lower bound on sleep schedule; if next required delay cannot fit in remaining budget, return retry_not_before without sleeping or incrementing counters
